operations.name: Server
operations.brief: MCP server-side operations. Processing of incoming MCP requests or notifications initiated by a client, such as tool calls, prompt requests, and resource reads.
operations.otel_notes: The span name follows the OpenTelemetry MCP server convention, using gen_ai.tool.name or gen_ai.prompt.name when applicable. The mcp.server span operation is a Sentry categorization.

operations.name: Notification
operations.brief: MCP notifications. One-way messages exchanged between an MCP client and server that do not expect a response.
operations.otel_notes: The span name follows the OpenTelemetry MCP convention for notifications. OpenTelemetry uses CLIENT spans for the sender and SERVER spans for the receiver; the directional notification operations listed here are Sentry categorizations.
